name: dsh-hmos-sidebar
description: HarmonyOS developer workbench as a floating DSH web panel (Windows-only). Host half serves action-level /hmos/api/* RPC (build/clean/logs/screenshot/start/install/probe/hap-info/device); client half is a self-contained floating UI (no better-sidebar dependency) plus an official Settings card (settings.plugin.item) controlling floating-ball visibility and popup auto-expand defaults. The 41 dcli__* model tools are NOT registered by the main entry: presets mount them separately via the "./tools" export (lib/dcli-tools.mjs). Shared lib/environment.js unifies cli/Studio/hdc/hvigor/json5/project-root resolution.
